name: jstack
description: jstack: Claude Code skills for shipping the work of many parallel AI coding agents from one laptop (merge trains, one build and one PR, a machine-wide build lock, web performance A/B).

plugins.name: jstack
plugins.description: /train ships many agent branches as one build and one PR; /optimize measures and proves speed fixes. /grill-me and /wayfinder plan the work first. Plus the heavy-job lock and worktree scripts.

plugins.name: jay-claude-switcher
plugins.description: Side panel with every stored Claude account's 5-hour and weekly usage, sorted by nearest reset, and an auto-switch to the least-used account at 99% (or on the limit error itself) that a running session picks up on its next request. Plus switch.py and an add-account skill.

plugins.name: unslop
plugins.description: /unslop:explain (why each finding matters, with sources and before/after evidence), /unslop:metrify (does the slop stop recurring?), /unslop:retro (what escaped and which question would have caught it). Uses the jstack tools.
